scenario.title: Evangelion Battle Asuka: The Detective's Conundrum
scenario.logline: In a world on the brink of disaster, Asuka uncovers a hidden threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever.
scenario.synopsis: As the Third Child of NERV, Asuka struggles to maintain her composure amidst the constant battles against Angels. However, when a mysterious artifact appears, she takes it upon herself to unravel its secrets with the help of a local detective, ultimately leading them both on an adventure that will test their courage and resolve.

Act 3: Conclusion and implications for Asuka's future
